_comment: Player moves and movement for the fight scene (issue #10, spec docs/specs/player-controls.md). Timings are whole simulation ticks at tickRate (60 ticks = 1 second; seconds in each _comment are for humans only). Distances are metres along the side-on X axis, measured between fighter root positions. All values are GAMEPLAY ABSTRACTION tuning values, not measured boxing data; the boxing review (work/10) set the jab/cross gap so the cross is a bit slower and heavier, not clearly slower.

jab._comment: Lead hand. 6/3/9 ticks = 0.10 s / 0.05 s / 0.15 s, total 18 ticks = 0.30 s. Startup matches a measured throw-to-contact of about 0.12 s; the total is deliberately snappier than a real whole punch (about 0.4 to 0.5 s).

cross._comment: Rear hand. 8/4/14 ticks = 0.13 s / 0.07 s / 0.23 s, total 26 ticks = 0.43 s (about 1.44 x the jab total). A bit slower and heavier than the jab, slightly longer reach; the gap is small on purpose because real jab and cross speeds are close. Keep cross total <= 1.5 x jab total so the one-two stays usable (checked by AC3).

slip._comment: 3/15/12 ticks = 0.05 s / 0.25 s / 0.20 s, total 0.50 s. Evading only during active. Recovery can be cancelled into a punch (counter). No source gives real slip durations: tuning values.

guard._comment: Hold to guard. 4 ticks = 0.07 s before blocking counts. Walking speed is multiplied while guard is raising or up.

movement._comment: Walk speed in m/s. minX is the furthest the player can back up (must be <= fighters.json ring.playerX and on the visible floor). minSeparationM is the closest the player's root may get to the opponent's root.

feedback._comment: On-screen 'Contact: Jab/Cross' text duration. 45 ticks = 0.75 s.

visual._comment: Pose offsets for the code-driven move animation, fractions of fighter height (H) or width (W) as in fighters.json body. Developer may tune within about 30 percent so the move reads well; tune punchExtendH so a punch at gap == reach visibly reaches the opponent.
